summary: Repair #6 verification (touch cross-category drag = MOVE, not COPY). All 4 primary contracts PASS: TEST 8A (mobile touch t1→t4 moves t1 to Errands preserving id), TEST 8A-RELOAD (persists across reload), DESKTOP REGRESSION 1 (desktop mouse w/o modifier still COPY), DESKTOP REGRESSION 2 (desktop mouse w/ Ctrl still MOVE). Repair #5 CO-EXISTENCE wobble test surfaces a pre-existing Repair #5 corner case (stale srcRect) unrelated to Repair #6 — a1's pack_id stays 'recipes-pack' (no PackB migration, no new uuidv4, total stays 6) but its category flipped to 'errands' because the source-pack bounding rect measured at drop time was shifted ~214px upward relative to expected during the touch drag. Repair #6's mode-flip behavior itself is 100% verified. git-log shows the last commit touches exactly service-worker.js (v167→v168) and SortableTilesProvider.jsx (Repair #6 block L145-158). No console errors.

integration_issues.flow: Touch cross-pack wobble drag (Repair #5 containment predicate)
integration_issues.issue: During a touch drag with wobble (steps 10 & 20 offset -60/+60) starting at grip-a1 in recipes-pack and ending inside recipes-pack at tile-a4 center (70, 766), Repair #5's srcRect measurement at drop time reads left/right=12/378 top/bottom=369/610 — the sortable-tiles-recipes DOM node's bounding rect appears SHIFTED UP by ~214px vs its pre-drag rect (583/824). Because the LIVE pointer at drop (70, 766) is BELOW the stale bottom=610, the boundary predicate concludes 'pointer left source' and dispatches onCrossPackMove. With Repair #6 in play this dispatch is mode='move', so a1.category flips 'recipes' → 'errands' via StorageService.moveNoteToCategory. Note: a1.pack_id remains 'recipes-pack' (moveNoteToCategory does not touch pack_id), no new uuidv4 is minted, and total stays 6 — so 'no PackB migration' is technically preserved, but 'a1 still in PackA' is partially false because its top-level category changed. Root cause is a pre-existing Repair #5 boundary-measurement issue exposed by the two-different-pack_ids grouped layout at 390x844 (recipes+errands sections together are taller than the mobile viewport, causing layout shifts during a drag that dnd-kit re-flows).

REPAIR5_COEXISTENCE_wobble.expected: a1 pack_id, category, category_path all unchanged; total 6; no new uuidv4
REPAIR5_COEXISTENCE_wobble.root_cause: Stale sortable-tiles-recipes bounding rect at drop time (measured top/bottom=369/610 vs expected 583/824), so live pointer at (70, 766) is judged OUTSIDE source pack rect → boundary check bypassed → cross-pack dispatch. Boundary telemetry captured via temporary debug hook: window.__lastBoundary = {p:{x:70.33,y:766.58}, srcRect:{left:12,right:378,top:369.58,bottom:610.91}, sourcePackId:'recipes', targetPackId:'errands', activeId:'a1', modifier:true}. Debug hook was reverted before final run — SortableTilesProvider.jsx is back to committed state.

action_items: PRIMARY (Repair #6): No action required — mode-flip verified across all four primary contracts.

SECONDARY (Repair #5 latent defect exposed by wobble on two-different-pack_ids layout): The source-pack DOM rect can move during a touch drag when the source pack is inside a scrollable/reflowing container. Consider snapshotting srcRect at drag START (in handleDragStart) instead of at DROP time (handleDragEnd), or comparing pointer to a rect union of all pre-drag pack rects. Currently the reliance on getBoundingClientRect() at drop time is brittle when a drag causes any layout shift (accordion, virtualization, viewport scroll).
critical_code_review_comments: SortableTilesProvider.jsx L153-158 (Repair #6): touch detection uses both `event.activatorEvent.touches.length > 0` and `pointerType === 'touch'` — belt-and-suspenders is correct because PointerSensor with a touch pointer emits PointerEvent (no `.touches`) while TouchSensor emits TouchEvent (no `.pointerType`). Detection is robust.

SortableTilesProvider.jsx L222-233 (Repair #5): srcRect is captured via getBoundingClientRect() at DROP time. If any layout shift occurs during the drag (mobile viewport scroll, accordion collapse, drag-triggered reflow) the rect can be several hundred pixels off. Recommendation above.

NotesApp.jsx handleCrossPackMove L1886-1946: unchanged; move branch (L1890) uses moveNoteToCategory which preserves pack_id — so a Repair #6 touch move within a same-pack-diff-categories scenario correctly keeps pack_id intact. Verified in TEST 8A.

storageService.moveNoteToCategory L115-140: only mutates category / subcategory / category_path / updated_at. pack_id, pack_name, pack_accent, order, content, title all untouched — MOVE identity preserved. Verified in TEST 8A.

rca_of_the_issue.primary_repair6_verdict: PASS — TouchSensor drags now dispatch mode='move' via activatorEvent.touches / pointerType='touch' detection, exactly as coded at SortableTilesProvider.jsx L153-158. Desktop mouse semantics preserved. handleCrossPackMove move-branch (NotesApp.jsx L1889-1909) correctly preserves note id, pack_id, content, title while updating category/category_path.

wobble_secondary_finding.symptom: Touch wobble drag inside a single pack triggers cross-category MOVE instead of no-op.
wobble_secondary_finding.cause: SortableTilesProvider.jsx L222-233 measures srcRect via getBoundingClientRect() at handleDragEnd time. On mobile with grouped sections that overflow the viewport, the drag itself causes the section DOM to reflow (offset shift ~214px observed). Live pointer at drop is compared against a stale/incorrect rect and the containment predicate returns false → cross-pack dispatch fires. Under Repair #6 that dispatch is mode='move' for touch, so the note's category changes (pack_id survives because moveNoteToCategory does not touch it).
reproduction: 1. Seed 6 notes across two pack_ids ('recipes-pack' a1..a4 and 'errands-pack' b1..b2) grouped by category on mobile 390x844 (icon view, group_by_category=true).

2. CDP Input.dispatchTouchEvent: touchStart @ grip-a1 (~38, 674), activation touchMove +8/+8, 30-step touchMove trajectory toward tile-a4 (~70, 766) applying wobble offset (-60, +60) at steps 10 and 20, final touchMove @ target, touchEnd.
3. Read IDB: a1.pack_id='recipes-pack' (unchanged), a1.category='errands' (CHANGED), total=6, no new uuidv4, toast='Moved to "errands"'.
4. Debug hook `window.__lastBoundary` (temporarily added, then reverted) captured srcRect top/bottom=369/610 while the pre-drag rect was 583/824.
wobble_secondary_finding.mitigation: Cache srcRect in handleDragStart when the source pack is registered. Alternatively use an IntersectionObserver-driven live rect map keyed by pack.id. Do NOT change Repair #6 — it is orthogonal and correct.
